title: Suspension of Snake Venom
summary: Alchemical extract used for Serpent Fang Toxin.

fields.Extract: Combine 3 Venomous Fangs to make one Suspension of Snake Venom.
fields.Brew: Combine this extract with any Vitriol to make Serpent Fang Toxin.
